_comment: scripts/lint/orphan_header_check.py: engine/godot-src headers included by nothing outside tests/ and their own unit that are NOT staged policy code. Each entry names why it has no include consumer. The 2026-08-25 census debt was burned down on 2026-08-27 (threedi_compare moved to tests/threedi/, terrain/types.h deleted, serializing_sink.h STAGED with its owner named); never grow this list without a reason that names the consumer.

allow.engine/base/gameprofile/player_files.h: The player's and this machine's own files, which the editor's import never takes and its build never packs (engine/editor/import/import_plan.cpp, assets/asset_import.cpp, assets/install_view.cpp, project_build/build_plan.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/cbin/binary_config_text.h: The CBIN form and its ConfigFile text form, each into the other, that the editor's credits document holds a CBIN file by (engine/editor/documents/credits_type.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/def/def_hudpos_text.h: hudpos.def's lines as the game's parser is handed them, which the editor's HUD layout and HUD viewport place their edits by (engine/editor/preview/hud_layout_edit.cpp, engine/editor/preview/hud_viewport.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/env/env_source_issue.h: The .env reader's report of the lines it reads otherwise than the record holds, which the editor's environment document turns into its source findings (engine/editor/documents/environment_document.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/filelog/file_access_log.h: The original game's /FRISK file log, which the editor's Play reads once the game exits (engine/editor/run/launch_plan.cpp, engine/editor/session/play_controller.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/fnt/fnt_stroke_font.h: The stroke font assets/opennova.fnt and fixtures/fnt/synth_{1,3}page.fnt are minted from (tests/fixtures/minimal_fnt_gen.cpp, a test), which the editor's blank font writes (engine/editor/blank/blank_font.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/lwf/wav_source.h: The wave loader's acceptance walk and a source wave read and converted, which the editor's wave import, file card and sound previews use (engine/editor/import/wave_source.cpp, engine/editor/session/file_card.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/threedi/threedi_volume_so: A collision volume's convex solid the editor's model viewport draws (engine/editor/preview/model_collision.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/assets/mission_fixed_file: The files a running mission opens by a fixed name, which the editor's import brings with a mission (engine/editor/import/import_plan.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/mission/player_start.h: A player start placed in a mission, which the editor's Play from here stages (engine/editor/run/play_start.h, play_start.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/renderer/shader_effect_in: The tags a shader file registers (the fixed-function compiles, an effect's EffectInfo), which the editor's shader document defines as its symbols (engine/editor/documents/text_types.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.godot/src/register_types.h: The GDExtension entry-point declaration: consumed by its own register_types.cpp plus the .gdextension config's entry_symbol resolution at load time - the linker/loader is the consumer, not an #include.
